facts.text: For the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program, soil modeling should use multiple fidelity levels rather than a universal model.
facts.quote: For this program, soil modeling should be multi-fidelity rather than universal

facts.text: The heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program should use high-detail DEM or deformable-terrain simulation to understand stopping-distance sensitivity to soil, slope, payload, and tire or track interaction.
facts.quote: use high-detail DEM or deformable-terrain simulation to understand stopping-distance sensitivity to soil, slope, payload and tire or track interaction

facts.text: The heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program should fit simpler parameterized soil models for large scenario regression testing.
facts.quote: fit simpler parameterized models for the large scenario regression

facts.text: The heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program should retain targeted physical tests to confirm the parameter envelopes of its soil models.
facts.quote: keep targeted physical tests to confirm the parameter envelopes
